items.name: Record backlog levels cited in Q2 2026 guidance raise
items.claim: Carrier's earnings release states orders were very strong globally supported by continued data center demand, and cites record backlog levels as a basis for raising full-year guidance to sales of about $23 billion.
items.source_excerpt: Orders were very strong globally in the second quarter supported by continued data center demand. Given record backlog levels and our year-to-date performance, we are raising our full-year outlook and now expect sales of about $23 billion and adjusted EPS of ~$2.90.

searched.result: No numeric backlog dollar figure disclosed, only a qualitative 'record backlog levels' claim tied to data-center demand and the guidance raise.

notes: Carrier's Q2 2026 release names data-center demand as a driver of record backlog without quantifying the figure; no dollar backlog number is disclosed in the stored exhibit.

changelog.change: run pipeline: initial write from stored EDGAR evidence, one qualitative BACKLOG item (no disclosed dollar figure).
